_comment: Declarative list of external mailboxes to mirror + their local delivery targets. Edits land after `build.sh ship`. Secrets referenced by env var name; values live in sops-encrypted secrets.yaml. delivery_targets.host is the VM's WG IP (oci-mail = 10.0.0.3) because Maddy/Stalwart bind WG-only (Phase A); mail-puller runs with network_mode=host so 10.0.0.3 is directly reachable via the WG interface.
_disabled_comment: gws-primary and live-primary are parked here, not in .sources, because they have never had credentials: all six of their OAuth env vars (GWS_/OUTLOOK_ CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, REFRESH_TOKEN) resolve to one identical 11-char placeholder, so Google answers invalid_client ("The OAuth client was not found") and Microsoft answers AADSTS7000012. Left in .sources they retried every 30s forever, spamming the log and holding health_mail-ingest permanently red, which buries real inbound failures. Re-enabling needs a one-time interactive browser authorize per account (see secrets.schema.md) to mint a real refresh token into secrets.yaml; then move the entry back into .sources. The loader ignores unknown top-level keys (no serde deny_unknown_fields), so entries parked here are simply not run. NOTE: me@diegonmarcos.com does NOT depend on gws-primary for recovery - health_mail-reconcile covers it daily by diffing Gmail against the whole maddy store by Message-ID and re-injecting over SMTP, using service-account creds that already work. diegonmarcos@live.com has no such fallback and is currently not mirrored at all.
